text:
Maya C: Quick sync — planning v2.15 rollout across US / EU / APAC. Proposed windows below. Need confirmation on DB migration timing, branch cutoffs & canary order.

Liam H: Ack. Can we shift EU canary +1h to avoid regional peak? Also we should lock feature flags before canary.

Olivia S: +1 to shifting EU canary. DB migration is two short steps; prefer running after EU canary and before APAC full. Propose 2026-07-10 12:30 UTC for migrate.

Raj P: Oncall ok for those windows. Will monitor long-tail token queues and latency. @Paul add runbook please.

Paul (oncall): I'm available for the whole window. I'll run migration on staging first and prep rollback steps. Please add me to canary rotation.

Deploy Bot: Pipeline scheduled: v2.15-staggered -> canary-US @2026-07-10T02:00Z, canary-EU @2026-07-10T09:00Z, full-APAC @2026-07-10T22:00Z.

Maya C: Updated plan below and pasted as a quick table so it's easy to copy into calendar / release notes. Please ack or propose tiny tweaks.

```
US canary:      2026-07-10T02:00Z
EU canary:      2026-07-10T09:00Z  (shifted +1h per Liam)
DB migrate:     2026-07-10T12:30-12:45Z
Full APAC:      2026-07-10T22:00Z
Branch cutoff:  2026-07-09T18:00Z
Changelog freeze:2026-07-09T20:00Z
```

Olivia S: Also remember to bump helm chart app.version=2.15 and add changelog entry under "ops: rollout windows". I'll prepare the changelog PR.

Liam H: I'll open the cut/merge PRs and a tiny CI preflight to validate model artifacts. @Raj please review the preflight when it's up.

Raj P: Will review. Add me to the preflight reviewers list.

Paul (oncall): :thumbsup: One ask — can we run a short KV cache warmup job 30m before each canary? Saves a bunch of cold-start tail latency.

Maya C: Good call, adding warmup job 30m prior. I'll post a final reminder 24h before and again at T-1h for each region. Thanks everyone.
